outcome: Confirmed or suspected maternal infection within 6 weeks of giving birth
Ability to sit comfortably to feed the baby
cohort: The study included 3427 women who had an operative vaginal birth at >= 36 weeks' gestation and met specific inclusion/exclusion criteria across 27 maternity units.
finding: A single dose of intravenous prophylactic co-amoxiclav after operative vaginal birth significantly reduced the likelihood of confirmed or suspected maternal infection within 6 weeks postpartum (11% vs 19% in placebo group).
mod_finding: The administration of a single intravenous dose of prophylactic co-amoxiclav after operative vaginal birth was found to significantly reduce the risk of maternal infection.
